What you get

Three things the app does every trading day.

  1. 01

    Daily signals for 100+ TWSE stocks

  2. 02

    Institutional flows and sector rotation

    See where foreign investors, investment trusts and dealers are buying, and which sectors the money is moving into.

  3. 03

    AI summary on every stock page

    A short plain-language read of the day’s signal, price action and flows, grounded in the published data.
